title: Quaint Malty Ukrainian Pork Dumplings
description: Hearty Ukrainian pork dumplings filled with a malty and savory mixture, perfect for a midnight craving. The tamarind paste adds a unique flavor dimension.
instructions: Combine the flour, malt syrup, and a pinch of salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add the ground pork, tamarind paste, rendered pork fat, egg, black pepper, and remaining salt to the bowl.
Mix the ingredients until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
